BiblicalUsage: Once, in the pursuit of Abner: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner, and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon. The name is a hill on the road to the wilderness, and the sunset there is all the Bible says of it.
TheologicalSignificance: A hill named once at sunset carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the pursuit itself, that the chase ran until the sun went down and the hill was the mark of how far it had gone.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
